sloka: स गत्वा यमुनातीरं सप्तरात्रोषितः पथि ।ऋषीणां पुण्यकीर्तीनामाश्रमे वासमभ्ययात् ।। ७.६६.१५ ॥
transliteration: sa gatvā yamunātīraṁ saptarātroṣitaḥ pathi ।ṛṣīṇāṁ puṇyakīrtīnāmāśrame vāsamabhyayāt ।। 7.66.15 ॥

translations.english: Having traveled and stayed for seven nights on the way, he reached the bank of the Yamuna and obtained residence in the hermitage of the sages of pure fame.
